author: worker_1
belief: Robert Zemeckis has directed films across many genres including: comedy (I Wanna Hold Your Hand, Used Cars, Romancing the Stone, Back to the Future), science fiction (Contact, Back to the Future), fantasy (Who Framed Roger Rabbit, Beowulf), drama (Forrest Gump, Cast Away, Flight, The Walk), thriller (What Lies Beneath, Allied), animation/motion-capture (The Polar Express, A Christmas Carol), and war/spy thriller (Allied).

author: worker_1
belief: Robert Zemeckis is acclaimed: he has won two Academy Awards (including Best Director for Forrest Gump), a Golden Globe Award, and received nominations for five BAFTA Awards and a Daytime Emmy Award. His films like Forrest Gump (IMDb 8.8) and Back to the Future (IMDb 8.5) are highly rated.

author: worker_2
belief: Robert Zemeckis has won 2 Academy Awards (Best Director for Forrest Gump in 1995, and a Student Academy Award), 1 Golden Globe Award (Best Director for Forrest Gump), received 5 BAFTA nominations, and won a Daytime Emmy Award. He also received the Golden Plate Award of the American Academy of Achievement. This demonstrates he is an acclaimed filmmaker.
